summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Brookstone Growth Stock ETF (BAMG) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund actively selects US companies with strong earnings growth potential based on proprietary and third party research. It selects both mid- to large-cap stocks with a focus on the latter. BAMG was launched on Sep 27, 2023 and is issued by Brookstone.

holdings.infoBox: BAMG is an equity ETF with a total of 101 individual holdings. The top holdings are Microsoft stock at 5.37%, Apple at 5.24%, Alphabet at 5.19%, NVIDIA at 4.96%, and Amazon.com at 4.93%.
